Clasped expectant hands, inquisitive head tilt, open palms offered toward user, then clasp again. Readable approval/help/input request and distinct from idle.
Stationary focused chin-tap and finger counting; hands act on own thought process, no foot-running or props.
Folded arms plus downward and lateral head/eye inspection, blink, return to attentive forward stance. Clear inspection rather than working finger-count or outward request.
